nodes.summary: For a set $A$ of natural numbers and a real number $x$, the logarithmic gcd moment of $A$ up to $x$ is the sum of $\gcd(n, m)/(nm)$ over all ordered pairs $(n, m)$ with $n, m \in A$, $1 \le n \le x$ and $1 \le m \le x$.

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$, the gcd defect of the empty set up to $x$ equals $-1$.

nodes.title: Growth function of the dense-set construction

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$, the double sum of reciprocal least common multiples of the empty set up to $x$ is $0$.
nodes.title: Double reciprocal lcm sum of the empty set

nodes.summary: For a set $A$ of natural numbers and a real number $x$, the double sum of reciprocal least common multiples of $A$ up to $x$ is the real number $\sum 1/\operatorname{lcm}(n, m)$, summed over all ordered pairs $(n, m)$ with $n, m \in A$, $1 \le n \le x$ and $1 \le m \le x$.
nodes.title: Double sum of reciprocal least common multiples

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$, the finite set of elements $n$ of the empty set with $1 \le n \le x$ is empty.
nodes.title: The empty set has no elements up to any bound

nodes.summary: For a set $A$ of natural numbers and a real number $x$, this is the finite set of positive integers $n \in A$ with $n \le x$; it is empty when $x < 1$.
nodes.title: Elements of a set up to a bound

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$, the truncated logarithm $\operatorname{Log} x = \max(\log x, 1)$ satisfies $\operatorname{Log} x \ge 1$.
nodes.title: The truncated logarithm is at least one

nodes.summary: For a set $\mathcal{P}$ of natural numbers and $k \in \mathbb{N}$, $\mathcal{P}^{[k]}$ is the set of squarefree natural numbers $n$ whose prime divisors all lie in $\mathcal{P}$ and which have exactly $k$ distinct prime divisors; that is, the products of exactly $k$ distinct primes from $\mathcal{P}$. In particular, $\mathcal{P}^{[0]} = \{1\}$.
nodes.title: Products of a fixed number of distinct primes

nodes.summary: For every set $\mathcal{P}$ of natural numbers, $\mathcal{P}^{[\le 0]} = \mathcal{P}^{[0]}$, where $\mathcal{P}^{[\le k]}$ and $\mathcal{P}^{[k]}$ are the products of at most, respectively exactly, $k$ distinct primes from $\mathcal{P}$.
nodes.title: At most zero primes means exactly zero primes

nodes.summary: For a set $\mathcal{P}$ of natural numbers and $k \in \mathbb{N}$, $\mathcal{P}^{[\le k]}$ is the set of natural numbers that lie in $\mathcal{P}^{[j]}$ for some $j \le k$, where $\mathcal{P}^{[j]}$ is the set of products of exactly $j$ distinct primes from $\mathcal{P}$; that is, $\mathcal{P}^{[\le k]} = \bigcup_{j \le k} \mathcal{P}^{[j]}$.
nodes.title: Products of at most a fixed number of distinct primes

nodes.summary: There are constants $c > 0$ and $C > 0$ such that the following holds. nodes.title: Harmonic sums over products of distinct primes

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$, $\sum_{n \in \emptyset,\, n \le x} 1/n = 0$.
nodes.title: The harmonic sum over the empty set vanishes

nodes.summary: For a set $A$ of natural numbers and a real number $x$, this is the finite sum $\sum_{n \in A,\, 1 \le n \le x} 1/n$ of the reciprocals of the positive integers in $A$ that are at most $x$; it is $0$ when $x < 1$.
nodes.title: Harmonic sum of a set up to a bound

nodes.summary: For a real number $x$, the truncated logarithm is $\operatorname{Log} x = \max(\log x, 1)$. Here $\log$ is extended to all reals by $\log 0 = 0$ and $\log x = \log |x|$ for $x < 0$, so the definition is total; the paper uses it only for $x > 0$.
nodes.title: Truncated logarithm

nodes.summary: For a real number $x$, the second iterated truncated logarithm is $\operatorname{Log}_2 x = \operatorname{Log}(\operatorname{Log} x)$, where $\operatorname{Log}$ is the truncated logarithm.
nodes.title: Second iterated truncated logarithm

nodes.summary: For real $x$, let $\operatorname{Log} x = \max(\log x, 1)$ be the truncated logarithm, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm extended by $\log x = \log |x|$ for $x < 0$ and $\log 0 = 0$, and let $\operatorname{Log}_2 x = \operatorname{Log}(\operatorname{Log} x)$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
